name: Customer in a high-risk sector
description: Customer operates in a sector with elevated misuse risk, such as precious metals, gambling, crypto, arms, or money transfer.
fp: Most firms in these sectors are regulated and compliant.

Wolfsberg Group, Guidance on a Risk Based Approach for Managing Money Laundering Risks (2006)
